description: Searches, live and at full depth, for a profitable buy-on-one-market, sell-on-the-other loop after every venue fee, and returns the most profitable size or null. It is two separate transactions, so the second leg can fill worse than shown; this is a snapshot, not a guarantee. Only assets on both markets can have one. Free on qmax.exchange; a QMax server run with metered billing can charge a small fee for a found result.

asset.description: Asset symbol, for example CFB or QDOGE (case does not matter). qmax_list_assets lists the tradable symbols.

max_cost_qu.description: Most QU to put in (a budget); the search returns the best loop that fits

min_profit_pct.description: Only one with at least this profit as a percentage of the QU put in

min_profit_qu.description: Only an opportunity with at least this profit (QU)

name: qmax_check_arbitrage
title: Check an asset for QX/QSwap arbitrage
